data_point: Accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or fractional CFO firm
run_when: Code found accounting, CPA, bookkeeping or fractional CFO wording in the page title or headline.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company ITSELF sells accounting, bookkeeping, tax or outsourced finance services.
prompt.definition: Exclusions need positive evidence. Never exclude on an inference, an estimate or missing information. These firms are a separate buyer scored by their own profile.
yes_when: The company sells bookkeeping, accounting, tax preparation, CPA or fractional CFO / controller services delivered by its people
no_when: The company sells software (including accounting software) rather than accounting services
The company is in another business and only mentions its own accountant
unknown_when: The text is too thin to tell whether it sells services or software
watch_out_for: Accounting SOFTWARE companies are not accounting firms
A tech-enabled bookkeeping service where accountants do the work IS an accounting firm
A company offering 'find an accountant' marketplace features is not itself a firm

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.note: An exclusion found on the web counts only with high confidence and an entity match by domain.

examples.input_excerpt: Bookkeeping & Accounting Services for Startups. Get expert bookkeeping, CFO, and tax services. Plans from $99/month

output.evidence_quote: Get expert bookkeeping, CFO, and tax services
output.reason: The company sells bookkeeping, CFO and tax services.

examples.input_excerpt: Puzzle is accounting software for startups. Automate your books.

output.evidence_quote: Puzzle is accounting software for startups
output.reason: The company sells software, not accounting services.
